items.name: 1. Cheongun Village branch
items.desc: East of the Clinic/Hospital in Cheongun Village. Panel in the basement parking garage, on the left; card used in the back office room.
steps: Bring a Car Battery (gas stations; one may spawn in or around the bank). The reader says "READER LACKS POWER" until it is powered.
Insert the battery at the sparking electrical panel inside the branch.
Find the Rare "Bank Branch Vault Access" keycard (random spawn: teller counter, floor, shelves, tables).
Find the paper note with the first 3 digits of the 4-digit code (random spawn; codes change every match).
Use the card on the access door, enter the 3 digits, then guess the 4th. The 4th digit has not matched one of the first three in reported runs, so try the other 7 first.
Inside: 2-3 safes + loose cash; Gold Bars / Gold Skulls ($25k each), intel, sometimes a recipe. Put gold in your Secure Slot.
items.exfils: Cheongun Village exfils; Mirae Hospital Southern

notes: Resources (Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, Metals) break down on pickup and do not use a Stash slot.
Secure Slot holds 1 item through a failed extract (key, manual, recipe, or Gold Bar).
Bank I is 20,000. Bank II is 50,000. Stash Item I is 10,000 plus 10 Rigid Synthetics and 10 Electronic Sensors.

heistSteps: Bring a Car Battery (gas stations; one may spawn in or around the bank). The reader says "READER LACKS POWER" until it is powered.
Insert the battery at the sparking electrical panel inside the branch.
Find the Rare "Bank Branch Vault Access" keycard (random spawn: teller counter, floor, shelves, tables).
Find the paper note with the first 3 digits of the 4-digit code (random spawn; codes change every match).
Use the card on the access door, enter the 3 digits, then guess the 4th. The 4th digit has not matched one of the first three in reported runs, so try the other 7 first.
Inside: 2-3 safes + loose cash; Gold Bars / Gold Skulls ($25k each), intel, sometimes a recipe. Put gold in your Secure Slot.

gaps: Dead drops: 42 spawn points exist (GGRanked) but individual coordinates were not transcribed, so they are not on the map.
Hidden caches: only 12 of ~59 spawn points are pinned.
Key positions marked "approx." are placed at the parent POI, not the exact door.
NuriGO West and Songdo bank panel/door spots are undocumented; Grid tower vault code lock unconfirmed.
Exfil pins are community positions; only 3-4 are live per match.
Main NK Battle Tank location unknown; Bale, Warden, Jin-Tae, Chemist, Iskra positions are at their home POI.
X01 (Season 1, Nov 5, 11 PM CT) not included.
The coastline/playable outline is a coarse low-resolution trace and the grid is estimated.

threatCrosscheck.note: Side of the border and the per-zone list are CODMunity's. The threat field on each POI is unchanged. A conflict entry keeps both accounts.

locations.conflict: Our threat string already keeps both accounts of the village: Low (metaradar) and High (dmzmap), plus Casino High. CODMunity rates Cheongun Village Low and Heavenly Luck Casino High, so it agrees with metaradar and disagrees with dmzmap's High for the village.
Our data rates NuriGo Mall as High. CODMunity splits it: NuriGO West High and NuriGO East Medium.
Both rate the tech complex Extreme. Our data spells it Netshin Tech Complex. CODMunity spells it Nenshin Tech Complex.
